description: Standalone Delaware job wrapper with explicit retained-release reuse or fixed native acquisition, durable receipts and separate license-based organization semantics. This contract does not replace historical de-business-licenses manifests.

retainedManifest.description: Explicit immutable local release to verify and reuse without acquisition or pointer changes. Omission requests a fresh acquisition.

redirect_policy: Reject redirects; fixed HTTPS metadata and selected-field resource paths for dataset 5zy2-grhr. Retained mode performs no network requests.
retry: At most five serial attempts per response. Honor Retry-After without shortening; waits exceeding one day defer. Whole-build deadline and cumulative limits can stop earlier. No automatic job restart or blind reacquisition after failure.
checkpoint: Persist immutable start and terminal job receipts. A successful receipt binds an independently verified immutable release manifest and its coverage. Retained mode references existing evidence without rewriting it. Failed or cancelled jobs preserve diagnostics and any published release; inspect before recovery.
idempotency: Each invocation allocates a new UUID job. Explicit retained mode avoids a duplicate download; omission is a fresh acquisition, not an implicit freshness cache. Historical jobs and source releases are not overwritten.
cancellation: Cooperative before publication; fresh owned staging cleanup only when ownership is certain. After the source commit boundary finish bounded publication or report DE_PUBLICATION_INCOMPLETE. Cancelled control outcomes may retain complete or partial publication and require inspection, not rollback assumptions. Forced process death and OS stalls are not transactionally recovered.
retention_profile: Internal selected evidence and local-review-only normalized records; preserve immutable source releases and durable job receipts. No automatic deletion or public record-level export.
